newsitem.title: USA: Strong opens Common Stock Fund.
newsitem.headline: Strong opens Common Stock Fund.

text.p: Strong Capital Management Inc said it has reopened its Strong Common Stock Fund, which has been closed to investors since 1993.
Strong said the fund, which invests in small and medium-sized companies, has reopened on a limited basis to investors making 1996 and 1997 IRA contributions.
It said it will stop accepting accounts on April 15, or when new assets reach $30 million, whichever comes first.
The fund was closed in March 1993, when assets reached about $500 million. The fund has since grown to about $1.2 billion in assets.
